title: Update Delete Algorithm To Allow Pieces And Connections Selection
description: The compose algorithms delete input selection should allow both pieces and connections to be selected.
summary: Fixed MCP design viewer fallback so design-intent tool results no longer render ComposeKit when diagram is empty/mode is non-diagram. Added unit coverage for the fallback gating. Also refactored engine MCP session storage from WeakKeyDictionary to plain dicts so non-weakref-able session ids (used by tests/hosts) work reliably; engine tests now pass.
